svg.text: rx_bb: baseband, three stages (one per arm)
stage 1 20/1 ×16 um, 200 uA, 10 kOhm (DC-coupled to the mixer); stages 2 / 3 4/1 ×2 um, ~4 uA, 200 kOhm + 4.0 pF: two poles near 230 kHz (-3 dB about 145 kHz)
AC couplings: pfet gate caps; Mr (gate vgr, ~60 MOhm) || pseudo-resistor to vb: high-pass about 9 kHz in all; source: sim/rx/rx_bb.py block()
